notes.title: Month of Mayhem SHiFT Codes
notes.content:
[h3]Weekly Golden Keys[/h3]
Every Friday during the Month of Mayhem, we're making it [i]rain[/i] Golden Keys with SHiFT codes that unlock 3 Golden Keys each in [url=https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands/][b]Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition[/b][/url], [url=https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-2/][b]Borderlands 2[/b][/url], [url=https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-the-pre-sequel/][b]Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel[/b][/url], and [url=https://borderlands.2k.com/borderlands-3/][b]Borderlands 3[/b][/url] for a total of 12 Golden Keys each week.

SHiFT Code:
RRRJT-B5TB3-J3JBJ-BJJJB-WTHSS

[h3]Weekly Weapons[/h3]
SHiFT Code:
CTWBT-Z6JJS-CBRJ9-3TJJJ-ZX3CK

When redeeming rewards in Borderlands: GOTY Edition, make sure to trigger an autosave (indicated by a Vault icon in the corner of your screen) to avoid losing your redeemed rewards after exiting the game. You can trigger an autosave by approaching a checkpoint, using Fast Travel, or entering a new map!

Make sure to redeem Month of Mayhem SHiFT codes on the Gearbox SHiFT site or via the in-game Social menu within Borderlands games before they deactivate on October 31 at 11:59 PM PT. As a reminder, each code may be redeemed once (1) per SHiFT account.

[h3]Borderlands Collection: Pandora’s Box[/h3]
Whether you're a longtime fan or a series newcomer, you can snag every Borderlands game to date with [b]Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box[/b], available on Steam.

If you own any Borderlands game within the Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box, you'll only pay for the content you don’t already own.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33369

notes.title: Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box available now!
notes.content:
[h3]Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box available now[/h3]
[previewyoutube=WeftwqV4FAA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33369

For the first time ever, get all six Borderlands adventures in one Mayhem-fueled package, all at an incredible value. [b]Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box[/b] is a digital-only bundle available now on PC via Steam, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4, and PlayStation®5.

This bundle includes all six acclaimed base games from the Borderlands franchise: [b]Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition[/b], [b]Borderlands 2[/b], [b]Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel[/b], [b]Tales from the Borderlands[/b], [b]Borderlands 3[/b], and [b]New Tales from the Borderlands[/b], as well as all of their add-on content.*

Experience the iconic franchise that defined the looter-shooter genre with its over-the-top firefights, absurdly varied arsenals, and thrilling interplanetary adventures perfect for solo and co-op play. If you've been waiting for the perfect opportunity to dive headfirst into the series, Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box is the ideal way for newcomers and veterans to get every Borderlands game to date in one convenient bundle. With four looter-shooters and two narrative adventures to play through, you better be prepared for maximum Mayhem.
[
[h3]Get 40 Golden Keys and more[/h3]
To celebrate the debut of Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box, you can snag a whopping 40 Golden Keys that grant you awesome in-game loot!

Claim 10 Golden Keys each for Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition, Borderlands 2, Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel, and Borderlands 3, as well as the Axton Vaultlander for New Tales from the Borderlands, by signing up to receive newsletters and digital marketing from 2K and Gearbox. Check out the instructions on the [url=https://borderlands.2k.com/][b]Borderlands homepage[/b][/url] for full details on how to get your rewards.**

Borderlands players know that Golden Keys are precious, as they're the only way to open the Golden Chest found in each game's hub area. Opening the Golden Chest grants you a random assortment of powerful gear that's always appropriate for your current character level. To use your Golden Keys, look for the Golden Chest in the following in-game locations:
[list]
[*] [b]Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition[/b]: Fyrestone and New Haven
[*] [b]Borderlands 2[/b]: Sanctuary
[*] [b]Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel[/b]: Concordia
[*] [b]Borderlands 3[/b]: Sanctuary III
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34826233/2c29156b08e469bd95d7d07c098c788526ab28e9.png[/img]
[h3]Month of Mayhem events[/h3]
In honor of Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box and two Borderlands game anniversaries this September, we're kicking off the Month of Mayhem, a four-week celebration of all things Borderlands packed with reward giveaways and in-game mini-events!

Stay tuned to get your hands on Golden Keys and max-level Legendary weapons for the looter-shooter Borderlands titles, Diamond Keys for Borderlands 3, and the return of the Loot the Universe limited-time mini-event! Be sure to check out the dedicated [b][url=https://borderlands.2k.com/news/month-of-mayhem]Month of Mayhem article[/url][/b] for the full schedule and details so you don't miss out on anything.

[i]*Includes all available downloadable content as of September 1, 2023. Dual entitlement to New Gen and Current Gen versions of Borderlands 3 and New Tales from the Borderlands included for consoles. All other titles available for Current Gen and playable on New Gen via backwards compatibility.[/i]

[i]**Requires a copy of Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition, Borderlands 2, Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel, Borderlands 3, and/or New Tales from the Borderlands. Users must opt-in to receive newsletters and digital marketing from 2K and Gearbox via a verified 2K Account or a verified SHiFT Account and log-in to your verified SHiFT Account in the game to receive rewards. Offer ends at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2025. Users will receive 10 Golden Keys each delivered in-game for Borderlands: Game of the Year Edition, Borderlands 2, Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel, and Borderlands 3 for up to 40 Golden Keys total if you own all four games. In-game loot granted by Golden Keys is randomized; weapons and gear shown above are for reference only. Axton Vaultlander will be delivered in-game in New Tales from the Borderlands. Please allow for up to a week to receive your in-game rewards. One redemption per SHiFT account. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.[/i][b][/b]
